a.lede: Just wait until you hear the bad news
a.title: Leaked IPO docs: Anthropic tempts investors with existential risk warning

b.lede: Anthropic serves a dire warning in its IPO prospectus, saying how a rogue model could lead to the end of humanity and, consequentially, its business. Nevertheless, investors are still hoping for a $2-trillion valuation once the company goes public.
b.title: Anthropic lists ‘existential risks to humanity’ as one of its risk factors in IPO prospectus
